text:
mike: quick proposal — for runtime sampled debug captures we enforce a default TTL of 48h for full request/response payloads, with route-level overrides down to 1h and up to 14d behind an enterprise opt-in. reason: reduces PII blast radius and storage costs. thinking also we should redact high-risk fields at ingest unless route is explicitly marked inspectable.

sana: +1 on default TTL. can we make the route override gated by two things: tenant consent flag and an ops-approval webhook? otherwise we'll have random routes leaking long-lived data. :shrug:

oliver: agree on ops approval. question: do we redact before sampling or after? if we sample first then redact we still store sensitive snippets in cold storage during the sampling window. prefer redact-first so samples are safe by default.

mike: good call — redact-first by default. sampling still occurs on the sanitized payload (we keep an opaque fingerprint for de-dupe). we should hash with rotating salt per-tenant for auditability.

kevin: ops/incident concern: sometimes we need ephemeral unmask for legal hunts. propose a breakglass flow: 1) short unmask token (1h), 2) 2-person approval recorded, 3) audit line in console. keep this separate from route overrides.

oliver: for console UX, can we show a small indicator on sampled captures: "sanitized" vs "redacted + fingerprint" and a link to request unmask with auto-populated justification? keeps clicks low.

telemetry-bot: NOTE: current pipeline supports per-route metadata flags: capture_ttl, redact_mode (full|partial|none), fingerprint_mode (raw|hashed-salt). default values are capture_ttl=48h, redact_mode=partial, fingerprint_mode=hashed-salt.

mike: thanks — can we ship a tiny config proposal for the SDK + runtime? something like:

```
route_config:
  capture_ttl: 48h
  redact_mode: partial
  fingerprint:
    mode: hashed-salt
    salt_rotation_days: 7
  inspect_override:
    requires_consent: true
    requires_ops_approval: true
```

sana: nit: redact_mode=partial needs a short doc that lists what "partial" means (emails, ssn, creditcards redacted; names pseudonymized). otherwise product will be unclear.

kevin: and add runbook steps for breakglass: who to ping, how to log the approval, automated rollback of the unmask token. ops should be able to revoke tokens immediately.

mike: next actions: 1) oliver to draft the console UX microcopy + button flow, 2) sana to write the redact_mode table, 3) kevin to sketch breakglass runbook, 4) engineering to add config + default to runtime (i'll open an RFC). can we sync tomorrow 10am?

oliver: can do — i'll drop a quick Figma and link it here before EOD.

telemetry-bot: ACTION CREATED: RFC-xxxx (runtime sampled capture defaults) by mike — status: draft.

mike: awesome, thanks everyone. we'll keep the defaults conservative and make explicit opt-in for longer retention/windowed unmask. :thumbsup:
